title: Riding in self driving vehicles
content: Frequent mall world experience for me. I usually feel anxious at first and relax/trust it. I don’t have clear memories of arriving anywhere tho. Seems like the whole period is just being in the self driving vehicle How often do yall have those dreams? Are you usually seated in the front or the back? How do you feel, relaxed, anxious, confused? Do you ever arrive at a destination? Is there anyone else in the car with you? Or just any other stories you have to share about it
